title: [review] tx_queue.py:416: confirm_transmitted() does not
description: The _remove_first() helper called by confirm_transmitted() updates stats but never signals entry.reservation.set_result(). If a packet pushed with return_reservation=True is removed via confirm_transmitted(), the awaiting coroutine hangs forever. Both pop() (line 405) and complete() (line 516-517) correctly signal reservations; this path does not.
close_reason: Fixed: _remove_first() now signals entry.reservation.set_result(True) when confirm_transmitted() path is used. This prevents coroutines from hanging when awaiting reservations on packets removed via confirm_transmitted().
